name.zh: 勇者之塔 第61层 刹洛眼、迪修眼、詹士眼

location.zh: 精灵太空站 资源区 勇者之塔

reward_note: No per-floor reward is recorded for 61-69.

capture.zh: 勇者之塔第61层：刹洛眼、迪修眼、詹士眼，Lv230，每只约1150血。

strategy_notes.zh: 因为对手首发超能，而且只有超能系招，光系强化三次即可；或厄尔塞拉6次光芒附体+八尺镜

engine_notes: Remake progression (V53/V54): floors are climbed in order from the ten-floor starting points 1, 11, …, 61; a loss, retreat or cancelled load keeps the attempted floor, and the party may recover between floors. The 2010 tower allowed no healing between floors and sent a loser back to floor 1 (4399 2010-04-13: 如果挑战失败，要重新从一层开打); fleeing kept progress (只剩一只精灵时除非胜券在握，最好逃跑).
Lv/HP from 聚侠 (61F Lv230 Hp1150 … 65F Lv270 Hp1350, i.e. +10 Lv per floor and HP = 5×Lv per monster); 66-70 are extrapolated on the same step.
迪修眼 (team[1]): reflects 1/4 of the damage unless the hit knocks it out (聚侠).
詹士眼 (team[2]): always moves first, even against priority skills (7k7k 2010-07-28).
source_note: 4399 勇者之塔61-70层简单攻略 (2010-10-10) and 聚侠 61-70层攻略 (61-65 line-ups with Lv/HP). The first-person 4399 report dated 2010-06-23 explicitly records Chaloyan using skill 20330 to sacrifice itself and strengthen the following Dixiu Eye. It confirms that specific Boss move and handoff, not all four moves; the remaining skill uncertainty is retained.
